meshy_tasks.prompt: Mirejaw, the depth stalker giant axolotl creature for a stylised 3D creature-collecting action RPG, the SAME character, same body shape, same pose and same proportions as the grey-background 3D model render, repainted to match the board reference but with PINK fronds. SKIN: dark slate-navy and charcoal (#2c3446) mottled camouflage of rounded leopard-like spots outlined in muted olive-grey (#6f7a62) over the head, back, legs and tail; a smooth pale CREAM (#efe2c8) belly, throat, chin and lower jaw. JAW: a clearly visible wide cream jaw line with pale cream lips, the inside of the slightly open mouth a soft dusky mauve-pink (#b88a9a) with small cream teeth. FRONDS: the feathery gill fronds on both sides of the head are bright PINK (#e27ac8 orchid pink to #f0a0d8 light pink), feathery and layered; NOT orange, NOT red, NOT crimson. TAIL: the tail is the same dark mottled skin all the way to the tip with a darker dorsal ridge; the tail tip is plain dark skin with no orange tuft and no bright colour. EYES: small amber-orange eyes with dark pupils. Stylised hand-painted creature-game look with clean readable colour blocks, Palworld / Pokemon Legends style 3D render, not photoreal. Full body in frame, plain flat light grey background, even studio lighting, no water, no scenery, no text. No red, no crimson, no maroon, no oxblood anywhere. Single creature only.

review: Board fronds are crimson; the coordinator's direction (red is Team Tether's) asked for pink, so the fronds are orchid pink.
